adjudication.rationale: The migration `20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb` inserts old `site_settings.embeddable_hosts` lines verbatim via raw SQL (`VALUES ('#{h}', ...)`) and does not normalize them. This bypasses the `EmbeddableHost` model’s `before_validation` scheme/path stripping. Later, `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` to `uri.host` (hostname only), so any migrated rows stored as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` will never match referers and `host_allowed?` will return false, causing `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to raise `invalid referer host` for upgraded sites. (The finding’s claim that the admin “cannot fix it” is overstated because saving through the model would run `before_validation`, but the migration/upgrade breakage itself is real.)
